scope: Focused read-only Python runtime implementation review against approved validation-context contract. No whole-system acceptance or formal-to-runtime refinement claim.
assessment: Dedicated _validation_snapshot uses canonical allow-app connection with default autocommit false and executes exact SET TRANSACTION REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY before three set_config SELECTs. Legacy transaction remains unchanged. No data SELECT or mutation precedes mode setup in this new path.

validation_context performs exact authorized _read and complete requested history projection on the same supplied connection. Nonempty requested sets scan every row; repeated kinds collapse and conflicting requested kinds raise. Empty IDs skip history only after mandatory exact-base authorization. No fallback lookup, new transaction, cache or early found-all exit exists.

Context result is returned after leaving the connection context; transaction/close failure prevents return. Data/decode failures become unavailability; missing document/base remain request errors. KnownRollback/UncertainCommit are explicitly converted for this read-only path, preserving legacy mutation classification.

Strict argument fields/revision/ID canonicality/count/encoded size are checked before opening SQL. Closed artifact outer shapes and strict stored JSON decode retain independent fresh-worker semantic validation responsibilities.

CLI measures complete encoded envelope before output, preserving nonce and producing bounded UNAVAILABLE on oversize. New path does not update counters, admissions, receipts or revisions; only transaction control, scope settings and SELECTs are used.
